english.title: Creditor under prospective regulated agreement fail to inform debtor details of failure to proceed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a creditor under a prospective regulated agreement, other than an excluded agreement, who decided not to proceed with it on the basis of information obtained from a credit reference agency, when informing the debtor of the decision failed to inform

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

that the decision had been reached on the basis of information from a credit reference agency and provide

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

with the particulars of the agency including its name, address and telephone number
english.legislation: Contrary to section 157(1) and (3) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
